title: LE,NONET Transition Seminar
description: Introduces Indigenous (First Nations, Métis, Inuit, non-status) students in their first year of postsecondary study to skills, tools and resources that support academic success in a holistic way. Topics include study, research and communication skills, time management and wellness.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of IED 191, IED 199 (if taken in the same topic).
